title: Microsoft Tech Support India Scammer Gets Trolled
description: I received a call from a man with a thick Indian accent claiming to be from Microsoft and he told me he received a report that my computer has "malicious files" that he will help me resolve. I am quite aware of this scam as I've done a lot of research about it and so I knew exactly what he would ask me to do so instead of hanging up like most people would, I decided to stall him for as long as possible and troll him in the process. I didn't get the entire call as I started recording part way through. For people that don't know, these scammers call you from India under a fake name and claim to be calling from within the US/Canada. Then they try to get you to download a program where they can get control of your computer and then they are free to do what they wish, such as steal passwords, banking info etc. They also get you to to give them your credit card information for a "small fee" to resolve "viruses" that you didn't even have in the first place. You would not believe how many people actually fall for this scam, especially elderly people. This video is NOT meant to be racist in any way as I don't hate any race/ethnicity but I do hate scammers. Please enjoy and remember to like the video and subscribe :D
